claims: Sean Miller is the head coach of the Texas Longhorns men's basketball team.
Sean Miller was hired as the 27th head coach in the Texas Longhorns men's basketball program history.
Sean Miller was hired on March 24, 2025.
Sean Miller was hired by Athletic Director Chris Del Conte.
Sean Miller previously coached at Arizona.
Sean Miller previously coached at Xavier.
Sean Miller had two coaching stints at Xavier.
As of March 2026, Sean Miller is leading the Texas Longhorns men's basketball team through his first season.
The 2025-26 season is Sean Miller's first season as head coach of the Texas Longhorns men's basketball team.
Sean Miller has over 20 years of coaching experience.
Sean Miller has a career record of over 480 wins.
Sean Miller has career winning percentages of .713 or higher.
Sean Miller's career record spans over 20 seasons.
Sean Miller has led teams to 13 or more NCAA Tournaments.
Sean Miller has led teams to multiple Elite Eight appearances.
Sean Miller has led teams to multiple Sweet 16 appearances.
In his first season, Sean Miller focused on rebuilding the Texas Longhorns men's basketball team roster with new transfers and returning players.
